description: This PHP class defines a model named PerformanceTrackerModel within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the Performance Api Model namespace. It encapsulates data related to performance tracking, including properties like id, tracker name, dates, status, and associated employee information. The class uses traits for serialization and implements normalization logic for API responses.
